response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT t.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT t.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry GROUP BY t.healtheval), all_statuses AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(r.site_count) AS average_distinct_sites, AVG(r.rate - a.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a WHERE r.rate > a.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A scan with zero duration has no defined file size per minute and is excluded from the rate average, but its site still counts as scanned.
